about: Credential testing only: the editor lists one world; the Platform key issuance is a World door. No API-generated world is created or stored in this scope.

decisions.demand: the editor tests a connected key
decisions.why: A read-only non-resource operation: authenticates WLT-Api-Key against the local account key hash and validates the page size; an issued account has no generated worlds.
an account and its API key are made in the developer portal, not through the API
